correctness.rationale: For all integers a,b>=1 and 0<=t<=min(a,b), classifying P3-free faces by maximum induced degree 1 yields pure-side simplices, all mixed edges, only triangles containing a deleted-pair diagonal, and tetrahedra corresponding to two deleted matching edges. Unmatched-to-matched cross edges occur in unique triangles and are free, so they collapse. The remaining unmatched-unmatched edges are maximal and contribute independent circles. The connected core retracts simplicially onto the t matched pairs by a contiguous retraction. For t>=2 that core is the union of two contractible pieces with complete-graph one-skeleton intersection, so its integral homotopy type is a suspension of a rank-binomial(t-1,2) circle wedge. t=0 and t=1 are treated separately. All homotopy steps are finite CW statements, not inferred from homology. Independent direct face construction, collapse/contiguity verification and exact mod-two Betti calculations agree on 127 parameter triples, a,b<=6. Remaining limit: finite checks support, but do not prove, the universal quantified claim.

originality.rationale: Inspected full-text statements concern P3-devoid complexes of forests, paths, cycles (Taylan 2015), ordinary independence of regular bipartite and categorical products (Nilakantan-Shukla 2017 and Goyal-Shukla-Singh 2019), and higher independence of complete multipartite/whiskered/trees/cycles (Deshpande-Singh 2020). The all-rectangular partial-matching deletion family at second-independence parameter is not implied by those statements: it is noncomplete bipartite when t>0 and uses a different face condition than ordinary independence. The t=0 and six-cycle boundary instances are prior-covered and are not claimed as separately original. published-finding corpus queries for aliases and exact multiplicities retrieved crown invariants or other simplicial constructions, not a covering formula. Equivalence under other terminology and unindexed work remains a risk.

value.rationale: This gives a complete natural classification for all complete bipartite sizes and every size of omitted matching, including the canonical crown graphs, rather than a selected finite case. The precise homotopy decomposition separates a residual 1-cycle family of rank (a-t)(b-t) from a 2-cycle family of rank binomial(t-1,2), revealing the dimension change induced by a full matching deletion. The structural free-face and retraction proof explains the phenomenon without reliance on finite experiments. The result extends the published complete multipartite baseline to a noncomplete class naturally adjacent to it; it may serve as a benchmark for higher-independence graph perturbations. Limitations: no maps in the parameter filtration or wider edge-deletion classes are claimed.
